sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.6 Locally - 27B Dense, 35B MoE, and Coding Variants ...
sources.snippet: The 35B MoE coding-specialised variants are tuned on SWE-bench training data. The coding NVFP4 variant scores in the same ballpark as Claude 3.5 Sonnet on SWE-bench-verified at a fraction of the inference cost. For day-to-day coding inside LU's Codex agent, the 27B dense Q4_K_M is the better default - consistent quality, no MoE-routing variance.
